selection_note: Curated favorable examples, not random or representative test samples. All six methods and both targets are retained; individual shared outputs need not outperform every baseline. Audio uses each full 31 s scene, with no cropping or per-track normalization. The original-reader examples contain different utterances from the same reader. These are prerecorded offline evaluation outputs.
selectionPolicy: Curated favorable complete-case examples. Rank all six-method/two-target complete scenes by mean shared-JNF gain over original JNF + 0.4 minimum shared-model target SI-SDR + 0.5 mean Lightweight gain over the stronger DISF/original-JNF baseline. Require shared-JNF minimum target SI-SDR >=10 dB. Choose highest ranked at SNR15 and a different scene at SNR0 with Lightweight minimum gain above -0.1 dB. Keep every method and target regardless of individual outcome.
causalityNote: DISF and both JNF-SSF configurations are noncausal. No verified-causality claim is attached to the archived legacy Lightweight outputs.
checkpointNote: Historical existing outputs; checkpoint identity follows the archived paper configurations. No matched Early/Late checkpoint is substituted.
